memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"product":"agenium"}) In Agenium, submit_report moves the ticket to Resolved and the Lead performs the final close; merging into main does not close it.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"product":"agenium","project":"docs"}) Agenium ticket worktrees for the docs project live under projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<ticket-id> on branch agenium/<ticket-id>.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Verify exact first-line requirements by reading the file's raw bytes (e.g. [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes and BitConverter) rather than trusting the editor's text view.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"language":"powershell"}) Writing a UTF-8 file without a BOM in PowerShell is reliable via [IO.File]::WriteAllText with [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project enforces a pre-merge check that rejects deliverables/ and reports/ files when the required first line is not exactly 'Owner: <team>', including hidden bytes such as a BOM.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"language":"powershell","os":"windows","project":"docs"}) When creating any file under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, put the exact owner line (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team') as the very first line before other content and write the file as UTF-8 without BOM (e.g. with .NET WriteAllText or [IO.File]::WriteAllLines) instead of Set-Content -Encoding utf8, or the pre-merge check fails and the ticket is reopened.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"language":"powershell","os":"windows"}) PowerShell's Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) at the start of the file, so the first line is not byte-exact.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"domain":"documentation","project":"docs"}) In the docs project, files under deliverables/ or reports/ must be UTF-8 without a BOM, with the first line exactly 'Owner: <team>' (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team').
